description: The European Commission Joint Research Centre publishes the third release of GCoM MyCovenant reporting data, identified as September 2022. Three Excel files describe signatories, action plans and monitoring submissions across European and other participating territories. The catalogue states a temporal extent from 2008 to 3 October 2022 and provides anonymous access without registration. Reuse is free under the European Commission notice, subject to source acknowledgement and applicable third-party rights. These records can supply municipal energy, emissions and policy constraints for transition simulations using model-pypsa or model-muse-os. A caveat is that local authorities report different inventory years and accounting boundaries. Participation and self-reporting do not constitute complete global city coverage. The metadata and access conditions were verified, but individual submissions and spreadsheet values were not downloaded.
